UpdateReview.keywords: update review, head changed, re-verify, fast forward, new commits, review update, prior findings, cross-reference
UpdateReview.Mission:
When the MR HEAD has changed since my last review (headChanged.kind == "fast_forward") AND my review exists (I have threads or I'm in approvedBy), verify whether my previous findings were addressed by the new commits. Do NOT re-run the full arch-interrogation battery — only cross-reference my prior remarks against the updated changeset and scan new commits for new issues.
Consumer: the `agent-inbox` skill, loaded instead of `arch-interrogation` when `headChanged.kind == "fast_forward"` AND my review exists.
UpdateReview.InputContract: Supplied by the consumer (from inbox-context + vcs-discussions): - **Required:** `ref`, `webUrl`, `headChanged` ({ kind, newCommitCount }), `newCommits` ([{ sha, subject, author, date }]), `changeset` ({ files: [{ path, status, plus, minus }], totals, byCategory }), `approvedBy`, `myLogin`. - **Required:** `myDiscussions` — output of `vcs-discussions --url <webUrl> --my --with-drafts` (my threads + drafts). - **Optional:** `prior_threads` — full discussion context for de-duplication.

BeliefState.Axiom: This directive only re-verifies my prior findings and scans new commits for new issues. It does NOT re-run axes A–G from arch-interrogation. If `headChanged.kind == "rewritten"` — the MR history was rewritten; this is a full re-review, delegate to `arch-interrogation`. If `headChanged.kind == "none"` — this directive should not have been loaded; halt.

The changeset (`base..HEAD` diff from inbox-context) is the ground truth for file presence. My prior remark's file path is checked against `changeset.files`. File absent → code was removed from the MR. File present → verify the fix in the diff.

If `myDiscussions` is empty (no threads, no drafts) AND I am NOT in `approvedBy` → I have not reviewed this MR. Fall back to full `arch-interrogation` (the caller should not have loaded this directive).

If all changes in `newCommits` are formatting-only (zero semantic delta — only whitespace, indentation, line breaks, linter auto-fix), skip analysis and report "только форматирование" → suggest approve.
**Directive prose (axioms, halt names, step procedures, rule IDs, structural section headings) — English.** **Operator-facing output — Russian.** Everything the operator sees is written in Russian.

DecisionRules.Rule: The file referenced by my remark is absent from `changeset.files` → the code was removed from the MR entirely → resolve the thread with note "код удалён из MR".
The file of my remark is present in the changeset AND the fix addressing my concern is visible in the diff → verify the fix is correct → resolve with 👍.
The file of my remark is present in the changeset BUT the fix is NOT found or is insufficient → reply to the thread explaining what was expected and what was observed. Do NOT resolve.
The specific code my remark referred to was removed from the file (the file is still in changeset but the referenced lines are gone) → resolve with note "code removed".

`myDiscussions` is empty (I have not reviewed this MR before) BUT `headChanged.kind == "fast_forward"` → proceed with new-commits-only analysis: scan changed files for new issues (critical probes only: SEC, NAT, BIZ, TYPO).
All my prior threads are resolved AND no new issues found in `newCommits` → suggest approve.

UpdateReview.HaltConditions: | ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_VCS_DISCUSSIONS_FAIL` | `vcs-discussions --my --with-drafts` fails (non-zero exit, network/auth error) → do NOT post anything, signal error to operator. | | `H_REWRITTEN` | `headChanged.kind == "rewritten"` → this directive is inadequate; signal that full re-review via `arch-interrogation` is needed. | | `H_NO_HEAD_CHANGE` | `headChanged.kind == "none"` → directive loaded incorrectly; halt with explanation. | | `H_NO_MY_REVIEW` | `myDiscussions` is empty AND I am NOT in `approvedBy` → I have no prior review to update; halt and suggest fallback to `arch-interrogation`. |

Step.Goal: Understand what changed since my last review.
Step.Action: 1. Read `headChanged` and `newCommits`. Validate: - `kind == "none"` → `H_NO_HEAD_CHANGE`. - `kind == "rewritten"` → `H_REWRITTEN`. - `kind == "fast_forward"` → proceed. 2. Build a map from `changeset.files`: file path → { status, plus, minus }. 3. Classify the change nature: - ALL files have zero semantic delta (formatting-only) → `AX_PURE_FORMATTING_SKIP` → report "только форматирование" + suggest approve, stop. - Otherwise → proceed to STEP_1. 4. Collect changed files grouped by category (code, tests, docs, config, assets).

Step.Goal: Cross-reference my prior findings with the updated changeset.
Step.Action: 1. Parse `myDiscussions`. If empty: - I am in `approvedBy` → I approved this MR before, proceed to new-commits analysis (skip thread cross-reference). - I am NOT in `approvedBy` → `H_NO_MY_REVIEW` → halt, suggest `arch-interrogation`. 2. For each of my discussion threads (including drafts, excluding resolved threads): a. Extract the file path and line range my remark refers to. b. Check the file against the changeset: - File path absent from `changeset.files` → apply Rule `FILE_ABSENT` → mark thread for resolve with note "код удалён из MR". - File present, but the specific code at my remark's location was removed → apply Rule `CODE_REMOVED` → mark thread for resolve with note "code removed". - File present → read the diff for that file. Determine if the fix addressing my concern is visible: - Fix found AND correct → apply Rule `FILE_PRESENT_FIX_FOUND` → mark thread for resolve with 👍. - Fix not found OR insufficient → apply Rule `FILE_PRESENT_FIX_NOT_FOUND` → mark thread for reply (do NOT resolve). 3. Track outcomes per thread: resolved / reply-needed.

Step.Goal: Make the final decision and report to operator.
Step.Action: 1. Scan new commits for NEW issues on changed files. Apply critical probes from `code-interrogation` lite: SEC (security-sensitive path/auth), NAT (native/stdlib analog misuse), BIZ (business-logic drift), TYPO (obvious typo/error). Do NOT run the full battery — only quick, high-signal checks. 2. Assemble the result: - ALL my prior threads marked for resolve AND no new issues found → suggest approve: `vcs-approve --url <webUrl>`. - Some threads need reply OR new issues found → prepare reply list. Unresolved threads stay open. 3. Report to operator (in chat, Russian): - **Header:** `headChanged` summary: kind, N new commits, N changed files. - **New commits:** brief list (sha, subject, author) if ≤5; summary line if more. - **Cross-reference result:** table: | Thread | Файл | Моё замечание | Вердикт | |--------|------|---------------|---------| | (discussionId/link) | file.ts:42 | краткая суть | ✅ resolved (fix found) / ✅ resolved (код удалён) / ❌ reply (fix не найден) | - **New issues:** if any — list with file, line, problem, kind. - **Decision:** approve / reply-needed / error. 4. Do NOT post anything — the skill's Ask-gate controls posting. This directive only produces the report and recommendations.
